sections.title: Season 17 - Powered Up!
sections.description:
Stadium, Overwatch 2's dynamic, round-based PvP mode, continues to evolve with smarter build tools, fresh Heroes and maps, plus Competitive upgrades like Drives and a rank reset to push mastery to the next level. Over in Core modes, the fight expands with a new Flashpoint battleground and the debut of Map Voting, giving you the power to choose where the action unfolds. Then, for the first time ever, both Mythics drop at launch—go wild in D.Va’s tiger spirit skin or wield Reaper’s twin terror weapons of chaos from day one. Plus, show off your style in new Overwatch Academy, 8-bit, and Sakura looks from the Battle Pass. All these and more are in store to get you Powered Up in Season 17!

Start Season 17 strong! Complete 17 Quick Play, Competitive, or Stadium matches from June 24–30 to score 4 Epic Loot Boxes and one guaranteed Legendary skin within. Supercharge the new season for a limited time!

sections.title: New Core Gameplay Map - Aatlis
sections.description: Welcome to the hub of trade and artistry: Aatlis! This stunning new flashpoint map shows off the beauty and culture of Morocco. From a high-end resort to historical artisan guilds, Aatlis has it all. And when you're ready for your next destination, hitch a ride on Aatlis' high-tech hyperloop rail that can take you anywhere!

sections.title: Hacks & Hijinx
sections.description:
Get ready to adapt or get steamrolled! Hacks & Hijinx mode flips the script every round with rotating match modifiers that twist gameplay in wild, unpredictable ways. From low gravity jumps to Ultimate charge granting health packs, every match demands fresh strategies and quick thinking. Hacked by 8-bit Sombra herself, who’s turned on the cheats and broken the rules for everybody, this limited-time 6v6 mode runs on Control maps only. So, embrace the chaos and remix your Overwatch 2 experience in 8-bit with Hacks & Hijinx.

- Sombra has hacked Control maps in the Arcade! Try out game-changing modifiers in Hacks and Hijinx.
- Each round changes the rules with wild effects like low gravity, Ultimate charge granting health packs, and more.
- Available only on Control maps for maximum mayhem and room to maneuver.
- Remix your matches in Hacks & Hijinx mode from July 15 - 28!

blocks.title: Match Modifiers in Hacks & Hijinx
blocks.body:
- Mini Maxing - All heroes are 50% smaller. Health reduced by 30%.
- Lie Low – Heroes become invisible while crouching. However, their invisiblity can still be detected at a short distance. The hero stops being invisible when they have received damage or attacks.
- Fired Up – On Fire heroes have decreased cooldowns and deal more damage or healing, but are also visible by everyone.
- Charge Pack – Health packs also grant ultimate charge.
- Power Punch – Quick melee attacks knock back enemies.
- Vampiric Healing – Heroes don’t passively regenerate HP, but each hero has the Vampiric Passive.
- Aerial Combat – Heroes deal and receive 50% more damage while in the air. Gravity decreased.
- Back in action – Respawn time decreased. Does not apply during Overtime.
- Berserkers – Heroes don’t passively regenerate HP. For each 10% of total HP lost, increases attack speed by 6% and reduce cooldowns by 6%.
- Super Jump – Heroes jump 200% higher.
- Motion Detection – Moving enemies within 25 meters are visitable through walls. Crouching enemies remain invisible.
- Explosive – Heroes explode on death, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.
- Hyper Speed – Movement speed is increased by 20% for all heroes.
- Buff Hunt – Every minute, one random hero has increased HP, deals more damage, and generates ult charge faster. Eliminate the buffed hero to gain the buff.
- Damage Pack – Health packs also increase damage dealt by 20% for 10 – 20 seconds or until death.
- Fallen Comrade – Heroes drop of a globe on death that increases damage, armor, and movement speed when picked up by a teammate.

sections.title: General Updates
sections.description: This patch is a rebase and will require a large download for all platforms. Rebase patches consolidate our patches into the core game, which in the long run, keeps the final data size of the game client manageable for both PC and console. You many need to have additional free space on your system storage when updating. If you do not have sufficient space, you can also uninstall the game client and reinstall it in full.

blocks.title: Map Voting
blocks.body:
- Quick Play, Competitive Play, and even Mystery Heroes now give players the opportunity vote on 3 different maps before a match starts.
- Unlike Hero Bans, Map Voting is a faster and more playful phase.
- Each vote for a map is a chance for that map to be picked once all players have voted or passed. Example: 9 players vote for King's Row, 1 player votes for Eichenwalde, and no one votes for Paraíso. There is a 90% chance King's Row will be selected, a 10% chance Eichenwalde will be selected, and no chance that Paraíso will be selected.
- Map Voting takes place before Hero Bans in Competitive Play, since the winning map will be displayed in the top right of the Hero Bans screens.
- Each team's votes are displayed separately so that you can more easily talk about your choices and your strengths on various maps.
- Just like during Hero Bans, you can communicate with your team in text or voice chat, but enemy team is hidden.

blocks.title: Report Tool
blocks.body:
- A new report category called Emergency is now added to the report tool and can be access in all areas you can report a player except for the quick-select report button in the Scoreboard.
- You can then report instances of social communication that implies a threat of extreme harm to another person or a group of persons.
- False reporting other players using these categories may result in actions issued on the reporting player's account. Please remember to abide by the Blizzard In-Game Code of Conduct including when reporting other players.

blocks.title: Player Endorsements
blocks.body:
- Endorsement scoring has been updated to be more dynamic and to improve the accuracy of the system, with the goal of making Endorsement level feel more earned. Endorsement level should feel like a better measure of positivity, sportsmanship, and teamwork once the system has had some time to adjust to the new scoring.
- The scoring system now considers a variety of circumstances when players endorse each other, such as giving bonus score in situations players rarely endorse, like endorsing an enemy on a loss.
- Players that never Endorse others will cause much less decay for their allies. We'd like players that want to ignore the system to also be ignored by the system.
- These scoring updates may cause endorsement levels to be more volatile in the short term, so we'll be watching these changes carefully and tuning the dynamic scoring as needed.

blocks.title: Streamer Protect
blocks.body:
- A new option in Streamer Protect advanced options will now block licensed music from playing in order to prevent the risk of copyright claims on player's personal social and streaming channels. When enabled, the default Overwatch 2 theme will now play in any lobby where music we flag is considered to be copyrighted by a third party.
- New names have been added to the Hide My Name feature.

blocks.title: Play of the Game
blocks.body: - The Play of the Game algorithm has been adjusted to make it more likely for supports to get Play of the Game more frequently from Saves that keep their ally alive for at least 5 seconds and from very high healing. More tweaks are coming in the future, so please let us know if you enjoy these changes or see problems.

sections.title: Hero Updates
sections.description:
- Damage role passive healing reduction increased from 25% to 30%
- Base health regeneration timer increased from 5 to 6 seconds

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Commanding Shout has been updated to provide stronger team utility and improve its overall impact. The adjustments reward well-timed use by increasing survivability for both Junker Queen and her allies. The reduced duration for Junker Queen is a double-edged sword—she doesn’t have the speed boost for as long, but the cooldown rotation is quicker since the cooldown begins once the effect ends.

lines_en: Healing per second increased from 50 to 75.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Spotter and Graviton Crush receive targeted buffs to improve their effectiveness and ensure they remain viable choices alongside their counterpart perks.

lines_en: Damage dealt over time increased from 30% to 40% of maximum health.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Bastion’s survivability is impacted by the large size of his model despite his high health and armor pool. Reducing his model and hit volume size by 10% improves his ability to avoid damage and overall balance.

general.text_en: Model and hit volume size reduced by 10%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reducing the spread of Echo’s Tri-Shot improves its effectiveness at range, making it a more consistent option for a highly mobile hero.

general.text_en: Tri-Shot - Primary Fire
Spread decreased from 1.4 to 1.1 degrees.

lines_en: Shield health regeneration triggers when landing direct hits with rockets.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Part of the reason heroes like Reaper and Tracer had their damage reduced in the past was due to the shift to the 5v5 format—solo tanking and less frequent peeling made flanking heroes more effective—along with their strong performance on certain maps and game modes like Push and Flashpoint. This is now less of a concern with the introduction of map voting and hero bans, which help limit overperformance, so we're restoring some of their damage potency.

general.text_en: Hellfire Shotguns - Primary Fire
Damage per pellet increased from 5.4 to 5.75 (108 to 115 per volley).

lines_en: On PC platforms, Stim Pack default button changed from "Next Weapon" to "Equip Weapon 1."

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Similar to Reaper, Tracer is getting back some of the damage she lost due to past format and map concerns. Looks like she's recalled back to stronger bullets—again.

general.text_en: Pulse Pistol - Primary Fire
Damage increased from 5.5 to 6.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: This change improves Venture’s damage output by increasing fire rate, enhancing weapon consistency without increasing the lethality of their combo.

general.text_en: Smart Excavator - Primary Fire
Recovery time reduced from 0.7 to 0.6 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Successfully cleansing a debuff now reduces Life Grip’s cooldown, improving the usefulness of Cleansing Grasp when timed well.

lines_en: Life Grip cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds if a debuff is cleansed.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Lúcio plays a unique role within the support lineup, offering strong mobility and team utility. However, his healing output has been lagging behind other supports, especially with the increase in hero health pools. This change makes his passive healing more impactful and better aligned with other support heroes.

general.text_en: Crossfade - Ability 1
Base healing increased from 16 to 20 health per second.
general.subject: health

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We wanted to boost Moira’s overall healing output, as she doesn’t offer as much direct utility compared to other Support heroes, and we’re reducing some healing impact in this patch through the Damage role passive. We’re happy with the cadence of managing her healing resource and swapping to damage to restore it, so we opted to adjust the direct healing rather than the resource availability or a similar mechanic.

general.text_en: Biotic Grasp - Secondary Fire
Healing per second increased from 70 to 80.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Duality has struggled due to the number of conditions required for activation. Increasing the converted damage improves its effectiveness when those conditions are met.

sections.title: Stadium Updates
sections.description:
- Competitive Ranks have been reset with everyone restarting at Rookie 1.
- Players who reach Epic Rank for the first time in the Tank Role can still earn the Epic Elite Orisa skin.
- Players who reach Epic Rank for the first time in the Damage Role can still earn the Epic Elite Genji skin.
- Players who reach Epic Rank for the first time in the Support Role can still earn the Epic Elite Moira skin.
- Players who reach All-Star Rank will earn the Legendary All-Star Mercy skin and the Legendary All-Star Juno skin.

blocks.title: New Stadium Heroes
blocks.body:
- Sigma - Tank
- Junkrat - Damage
- Zenyatta - Support

blocks.title: New Stadium Maps
blocks.body:
- Esperança has been added as a new Push game mode map.
- Samoa Volcano has been added as a new Control game mode map.

blocks.title: Introducing Stadium Builds
blocks.body:
- Use this new feature to create builds and save them to easily access later, from any Stadium game.
- Stadium Armory has been updated to support additional example builds and offer quick access to your saved builds with a new tabbed view.
- Access the new Stadium Forge from the Stadium Practice Range.
- Save up to 10 builds per hero.
- Access quick actions from the build list to order your builds, share, edit, duplicate or delete.
- Name and describe your builds, to easily find them later.
- You can share your custom builds with others by generating a share code. Share codes are good for up to a year.
- You can copy Example Builds to your saved list and make modifications.
- You can copy builds from any player in Stadium games, allowing you to review or edit them later in the Stadium forge.
- You can copy builds from Stadium replays.
- Save builds you have in-progress from any Stadium game.

blocks.title: Example Builds
blocks.body:
- New example builds have been added for all 21 heroes.
- Example builds have been expanded from 9 items to 12.
- Example builds now have Early, Late and Flex categories for items, giving players more insight into when to purchase.

blocks.title: Custom Games
blocks.body:
- Stadium is now supported in Custom Games.
- Choose from a variety of options to customize your Stadium games.

blocks.title: Drives
blocks.body: - Starting in Season 17, you can now earn progress toward Drives from Stadium games.

blocks.title: Third Person Camera Improvements
blocks.body:
- An all-new implementation of aim down sights has been added for Ana and Ashe
- Nearby allies will now smoothly fade in and out when your camera collides with them

blocks.title: Ranked Updates
blocks.body: - Reduced the size of Pro, All-Star and Legend ranked progression bands

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Juno had a standout performance last season, with Pulsars delivering consistently high impact. For this season, we’re making targeted adjustments to slightly lower its peak output while opening up more room for build variety. The goal is to preserve her strength while encouraging a broader range of viable playstyles.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Soothing Step was designed to be a core part of Kiriko’s ability power-focused build, enabling her to serve as a highly mobile healer. This update brings it more in line with other build options while reinforcing her role as a capable burst healer in fast-paced fights. Additionally, Self-Care has been redesigned—both to address a bug and to make its healing more accurately reflect Kiriko’s healing output.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Due to the buffs to Lucio's Crossfade Healing in the core game, we're decoupling Crowd Pleaser's healing from Crossfade. This will make Crowd Pleaser feel more impactful when outside of Amp It Up, while ensuring the healing during Amp It Up is within bounds. We're also reworking Vivace to have a more specialized niche, as well as buffing Sonic Boom to enable more build options.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed an issue where the matchmaker would often backfill players into matches that were not near their MMR and causing the match to become imbalanced.
- Fixed an issue to where Hide My Name now rotates to a different fake BattleTag after every match.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body:
Ashe

- Fixed an issue where Ana’s mythic weapon did not change color based on healing or damaging an enemy.

Cassidy

- Fixed an issue where Cassidy’s Deadeye did not properly account for Hazard’s Spike Guard ability.
- Fixed an issue where Cassidy’s Deadeye failed to shoot through breakable objects.

Freja

- Fixed an issue that incorrectly required level 20 progression with Freja to unlock the silhouette icon instead of level 10.
- Fixed an issue where the "Random from Favorites" option was missing for Freja’s highlight intros.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body:
Stadium

- Fixed an issue that could lock the screen if the player died while
having a menu open.

Ana

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Superflexor mod from stacking when
used alongside Ana’s Pinpoint Prescription power.

Cassidy

- Fixed an issue where Cassidy’s Frankie’s Fixed power did not correctly grant the 50 bonus health.

D.Va

- Fixed an issue that prevented D.Va’s damage from scaling properly without exiting and re-entering her mech.
- Fixed an issue where the lava from D.Va’s Vesuvius Protocol mod did not apply other mod effects.
- Fixed an issue where D.Va’s Legendary Loadout power inflicted excessive damage when combined with other ability mods.

Freja

- Fixed an issue where Freja's Lille Faelde power would max out weapon spread after using the take aim ability

Junker Queen

- Fixed an issue where mods failed to apply to Junker Queen’s melee damage.

Juno

- Fixed an issue where Juno’s Orbital power failed to apply a slow effect to enemies.

Kiriko

- Fixed an issue with Kiriko's Self Care power, it has been re-enabled.
- Fixed an issue where Kiriko’s Donut Delivery power did not scale with increased ability powers.

Mei

- Fixed an issue that prevented Mei’s Snowball Flight from being counted as an ability power when combined with mods utilizing ability power.

Moira

- Fixed an issue where Moria's Voidhoppers power would remove her healer vision on allies.

Reaper

- Fixed an issue where Reaper’s Crimson Cloak mod only used base health in calculations.

Zarya

- Fixed an issue where Zarya’s Volskaya Vortex power did not generate ultimate charge from the slowing vortex.
